posts.headline: Twenty editions in and Shake N Bakers are STILL the only unbeaten team in Busters Anonymous at 5-0 with a league-best 788.44 points, and triciagloston's 5.5 career average finish is getting buried under a mountain of Ws.
posts.detail: Nobody else in this league is undefeated, nobody else has more points, and yet this is somehow still the most underrated story of the season.

posts.headline: Thicks sits at 4-1 clinging to the top of the Booty Warriors, but a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish means that 2025 ring is starting to look like a museum piece, not a mandate.
posts.detail: One title two seasons ago doesn't erase a .500 career mark — the pressure is officially on Tyrique14 to prove this isn't just a crown collecting dust.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner is still stuck at 1-4, and the gap between a 20-8 career record, a league-best 1.5 average finish, and this current disaster has officially become the biggest fraud case in Busters Anonymous.
posts.detail: A franchise built on two straight top-two finishes is now staring up at the entire league standings, and the GPA jokes write themselves at this point.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way stays buried at 1-4 with a league-worst-adjacent 490.18 points, and Pharaoh23's bottom-feeder pedigree of a 10 average finish continues to deliver exactly what it promised.
posts.detail: A 6-8 career record and dead-last scoring output isn't a slump for Auntie Thomas — it's the franchise identity, right on schedule.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT drops to 0-5 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is now delivering a biblical-level drought that's lasted the entire season — the man who drafted a defensive player first overall is reaping exactly what he sowed.
posts.detail: A 13-14-1 career record says BigBoiEmos is usually just mediocre, but this 0-5 start is pure fire-and-brimstone territory, and the belt is winning in a landslide.
